subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with includeDetails be hidden in cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose paths, or should those detail-mode warnings remain visible?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface those detail paths, while the PR asserts all exec-like includeDetails warnings should be suppressed; automation cannot safely rewrite the policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Clarify And Revise Before Merge
options.body: Decide the policy first, then update the branch so the code order and regression tests cover the chosen behavior.

options.title: Preserve Detail-Mode Warnings
options.body: Keep the current cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose visible-warning contract and narrow or close this PR if suppress-all is not desired.

options.title: Accept Suppress-All Exec Policy
options.body: Move exec-like suppression before mutating handling and update the affected tests and proof to show the intentionally quieter behavior.

recommendation.title: Clarify And Revise Before Merge
recommendation.body: Decide the policy first, then update the branch so the code order and regression tests cover the chosen behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest current-history owner for the warning-policy and mutation-helper surfaces involved in the decision.
